observations.body: The LORD tells Moses what to say to Pharaoh and names Israel as son and firstborn.
observations.label: Israel is called God’s son and firstborn: action

observations.body: refusal to release that son is answered with a threat against Pharaoh’s firstborn.

payload.posture: Read Exodus 4:21–23 as a people under egypt evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Collective sonship and the threatened death of one household’s firstborn are placed in a compressed and severe exchange.
